title: Ashbury Rewards Direct Booking Recognition: Uplift on Relocation Compensation
content:
Ashbury Rewards recognises reservations booked directly with the brand. When such a reservation is relocated by the hotel, the compensation units of the relocated reservation are raised by a direct-booking uplift set by the booking channel shown on its Room Reservations record.

## Uplift by booking channel

| Booking channel of the relocated reservation | Direct-booking uplift |
|---|---|
| Brand website | 20 percent |
| Mobile app | 20 percent |
| Call centre | 10 percent |
| Directly with the hotel | 10 percent |
| Any other channel (online travel agency, travel agency through the global distribution systems, group rooming list) | No uplift |

**Rule.** The units are raised by a direct-booking uplift of twenty percent when the relocated reservation was booked on the brand website or the mobile app, and of ten percent when it was booked through the call centre or directly with the hotel. The tier's relocation compensation points are paid for the units as raised, and a fraction of a point in the result is rounded down to a whole point.

## Worked figures (hypothetical reservations)

| Compensation units | Tier's relocation compensation points, taken as | Channel | Uplift | Points for the raised units |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 10000 | Mobile app | 20 percent | 12000 |
| 2 | 5000 | Call centre | 10 percent | 11000 |
| 1 | 2500 | Directly with the hotel | 10 percent | 2750 |
| 1 | 10000 | Online travel agency | none | no uplift |
